_README: Per-card review status, consumed by tools/card_coverage.py.
The index's default inference — 'this card appeared in a game a reviewer
read, therefore it is checked' — OVER-CREDITS in three ways, and this
file is how a reviewer corrects it:
1. A reviewer does not check every card in a game. Only the ones named
in the prompt, plus whatever they trip over.
2. A card can be present all game with its relevant ability never
firing (Mutavault played as a land and never animated; Grim Haruspex
out while nothing died). Nothing was verified.
3. A card FIXED in the same session was reviewed against logs that
PREDATE the fix. The corpus shows the broken behaviour, so the fix
itself is unverified until a fresh batch runs.
Statuses:
verified   - live evidence, in a corpus at or after `since_sha`, that
the card behaved per its printed text. Retired from the
pool. Include what was checked, because 'I saw the tag' is
not the same as 'I verified the semantics'.
unexercised- present in a reviewed game but the ability in question
never fired. STAYS in the pool.
awaiting   - a fix landed AFTER the corpus that was reviewed. STAYS in
the pool until a batch at or after `since_sha` is read.
Keys are lowercase card names, matching data/card_data_cache.json.

akroma, angel of wrath.note: Protection was targeting-only: she was blocked by a mono-black creature and killed by a red board wipe. CR 702.16c blocking and 702.16e damage now honoured.

anger of the gods.note: Its 'exile it instead' death replacement now registers inline at resolution, and mass damage now routes through the replacement engine at all. Both postdate every corpus. Watch that an undying/persist creature it damaged is still wrongly RETURNED rather than exiled -- the SBA save branches run above the replacement check (pre-existing, same for RIP/Leyline).

angrath's marauders.note: x2 on its controller's sources and correctly controller-GATED - the opponent's damage back was undoubled.

archon of sun's grace.note: Static grant registered; constellation never had an enchantment enter after it.

arlinn kord.note: Her [0] made the Wolf and never transformed her, so the back face was unreachable. BOTH faces now emit transform_permanent (the [-1] transforms her too). Fixed after the corpus.

avabruck caretaker.note: Its beginning-of-combat trigger drained after combat damage AND targeted a planeswalker. Both fixed (drain ordering at the AI call sites; a real template). Fixed after the corpus.

avacyn, angel of hope.note: The 'Other permanents you control have indestructible' grant is now IMPLEMENTED (registration pattern + a has_granted_keyword branch with no is_creature gate). Fixed after every corpus that exists, so still awaiting. NOTE the deferred half: recalculate_granted_keywords still skips non-creatures, so the NON-creature side of the grant (artifacts/enchantments/lands) is not yet populated on _granted_keywords.

bant panorama.note: Played, and correctly refused its sac-search with no mana - but the search itself never ran.

battlefield forge.note: One of 8 pain lands that tapped for free under the old four-name list. Damage now read from the oracle, scoped per ability line so the free {C} ability stays free.

blasphemous act.note: Its self cost reduction could never match (the regex is anchored on 'spells you cast'). Cast at full price for four turns. Now -1 per creature on the battlefield, at the pre-gate and at payment.

bloodline keeper.note: Cast, cost-reduced, activated, token entered and attacked - but the token's FLYING was never tested (no untapped blockers).

boros signet.note: Same as Battlefield Forge - the tap is invisible in the logs.

captivating vampire.note: Its own P/T is correct and its ANTHEM was the subject of a fix, but the control-stealing tap ability was never activated.

cast down.note: Its 'nonlegendary' restriction was parsed nowhere (types_excluded was declared and consumed but never written). Latent in the reviewed corpus -- the observed target was legal -- so a fresh batch is needed to see it bite.

charcoal diamond.note: Entered tapped correctly; the mana ability was never activated.

crypt of agadeem.note: Entered tapped correctly in two games; the {2},{T} scaling ability was never activated, so the arithmetic is untested.

dark depths.note: Enters-with-counters fix landed AFTER this corpus; the logs show it entering with zero ice counters. Needs a fresh batch.

elesh norn, grand cenobite.note: Both halves, correct sign and scope, and she excludes herself.

elspeth's nightmare.note: All three chapters plus the CR 704.5s sacrifice.

embercleave.note: Same shape as Blasphemous Act and equally unhandled — '{1} less for each attacking creature you control'.

faerie guidemother.note: Its adventure half Gift of the Fae was +1/+1 board-wide with team-wide flying; now single-target +2/+1 with flying.

full moon's rise.note: Its Werewolf-only anthem was buffing the whole board; the qualifier is now honored. Fixed after the corpus.

furnace of rath.note: Correctly symmetric; the caster's own Comet Storm was doubled against himself. The May-30 house-rule removal stayed fixed.

gatekeeper of malakir.note: Kicker intervening-if correct on both a hand cast and a reanimated entry; entered tapped under Authority of the Consuls.

glacial chasm.note: Attack lock and life cumulative upkeep both fixed after the corpus.

glaive of the guildpact.note: for-each multiplier fix postdates the corpus.

goblin bombardment.note: Tier 3 resolved its 1 damage by fabricating a move_card kill on an undamaged 5/4 — and move_card never queued the death, so every dies trigger was skipped. Now resolves deterministically without reaching the LLM.

goblin rabblemaster.note: Attack trigger rewritten and the token half re-homed to beginning-of-combat, both after the corpus.

gravecrawler.note: Cast and attacked at printed power; never in a graveyard, so cast-from-graveyard is untested.

grim haruspex.note: Cast and attacked in two games; no nontoken creature its controller owned died while it was out, so the draw trigger never fired.

heart's desire.note: Token was named after the adventure and colourless; printed is a nameless 1/1 WHITE Human. Now follows the Lingering Souls convention.

hypnotic sprite.note: Creature half verified; Mesmeric Glare (the adventure half) was never cast.

icebreaker kraken.note: Re-checked, unchanged: its affinity reminder text has the same shape as the new self-cost-reduction parse and must not double-apply. Pinned in both directions.

ill-tempered loner.note: Now reaches the unhandled queue, but its damage-back effect still has no deterministic branch.

inscription of abundance.note: A kicked cast paid 5 mana and fizzled. Now a Tier-1.5 modal generator reading ctx['_modes'] + ctx['kicked']. The Tier-2 loop that caused it is still unfixed for OTHER modal spells — only this card is routed around it.

instigator gang.note: Its Attacking-only anthem was buffing the whole board. Now DECLINES with a breadcrumb rather than registering -- correct only in the safe direction; the buff itself is still unmodelled.

insult // injury.note: Both halves; aftermath zone gate correct in BOTH directions (rejected from hand, cast from graveyard); two-target split resolved. Its invisibility to MASS damage is the mass-damage handler's defect, not this card's.

killing wave.note: The cross-game dedupe that cancelled it was fixed after the corpus.

kozilek, the broken reality.note: 'Other colorless creatures' was mangled into a nonexistent subtype ('colorles') and matched nobody. Colour-absence is now a real predicate.

magus of the coffers.note: Both activation refusals were correct; the scaling arithmetic is untested.

mana confluence.note: Was filed as tap DAMAGE in a hardcoded list; it prints 'Pay 1 life', a cost. Reclassified — a payment cannot be prevented, doubled or redirected.

mesmeric orb.note: 'Whenever a permanent becomes untapped' had NO dispatcher. Now fires on the real tapped->untapped transition at the untap step and on the generic untap action.

mind's eye.note: Same inert family. Now pays {1} per drawn card when affordable (a real affordability check, unlike Smothering Tithe's uniform decline) and suppresses recursion.

mindcrank.note: 'Whenever an opponent loses life' had NO dispatcher. Now bus-driven from record_life_loss, which is where damage-caused and non-damage loss converge (its own reminder text is the argument for that placement).

moonmist.note: Was refused wholesale by the combat-shape guard, losing the transform AND the fog. Now a Tier-1.5 template, and the Werewolf/Wolf exemption IS modelled (prevent_combat_damage takes except_subtypes). Verify all three: the transform fires, non-Werewolf damage is prevented, and a Werewolf's damage still lands. NOTE fogs still do not prevent damage to CREATURES at all (pre-existing, engine-wide).

mutavault.note: Played as a land; the {1} animation was never offered or activated. The manland behavioural signal is absent, not disproven.

narfi, betrayer king.note: 'Other snow and Zombie creatures' leaked to the unqualified anthem and buffed the whole board. Needed both the subtype-list support and base_supertypes threading, which was never populated at all.

nightpack ambusher.note: TWO separate fixes now pending verification: the compound subtype anthem (registered nothing) AND the end-step intervening-if (CR 603.4 — made a Wolf on turns its controller cast spells). Watch both.

ob nixilis reignited.note: The [+1] dropped its draw and resolved only the life loss. Combined pattern added. Also newly reaches Asylum Visitor, which had no name key.

phyrexian negator.note: Passive damaged-trigger seam fixed after the corpus.

reanimate.note: Declared-target skip phrase fixed after the corpus; 45 of 49 casts failed in it.

reaper from the abyss.note: Morbid intervening-if correctly declined on five separate end steps (CR 603.4).

reckless waif.note: Full classic werewolf cycle: transformed, back face declined correctly on later upkeeps, attacked at back-face P/T.

sengir vampire.note: Dies-trigger premise gate correct five times. Its 4 damage failing to kill was Selfless Spirit's indestructible, not a defect - the reviewer's closest false positive.

sheoldred, the apocalypse.note: Opponent-draw drain was silently inert — the dispatcher was a two-card hardcoded elif chain with no fallthrough. Both of its clauses now fire on their own scopes.

shepherd of the flock.note: Adventure cost selection exemplary - creature half failed for mana, adventure cost used instead, exile tracked, creature half re-offered. Printed-target width is a separate MINOR.

silverflame squire.note: Its adventure half On Alert was +2/+1 board-wide with no untap; now single-target +2/+2 plus the untap. Also needed the adventure path to start forwarding the declared target at all.

sunforger.note: 'Unattach this Equipment' was in NEITHER activation path's cost vocabulary, so the ability was activatable while unattached and never detached. COST only; the tutor-and-free-cast effect stays unimplemented deliberately.

sword of light and shadow.note: Its combat-damage trigger now queues and its granted protection now parses - neither is in this corpus.

talisman of impulse.note: One of 8 Talismans that tapped for free. Same per-line scoping.

tendershoot dryad.note: 'Saprolings you control get +2/+2' has no 'other' and no 'creatures', so it matched no branch and registered nothing. The Aug-10 blessing-condition fix was necessary but not sufficient -- it only let execution REACH this ladder.

underworld sentinel.note: Attack trigger exiled a creature card from the graveyard with the dies-trigger link. The apparent self-exile was a Feldon TOKEN attacking while the real card was the exiled object.

usher to safety.note: Template narrowed to creatures while the printed adventure half says 'target PERMANENT you control' — the handler was already permanent-general, so the narrowing was in the template. Pick chain now spans every permanent type.

vampire nighthawk.note: Its own keywords are verified, but the subtype anthem it should RECEIVE was fixed after the corpus.

vile entomber.note: ETB tutor to the correct zone (graveyard, not hand); deathtouch body present.
